extraction.name: Video-MME
extraction.description: The first-ever full-spectrum, MultiModal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis.
extraction.creator: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The construction of the Video-MME dataset involves three main steps: video collection, question-answer annotation, and quality review.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtered out QA pairs that could be answered solely based on textual questions using Gemini 1.5 Pro.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators viewed the entire video and iteratively created three relevant questions, each with four candidate options.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Each QA pair was examined by a different annotator to verify clear language expression, answerability, logical consistency of options, and appropriateness of the correct answer.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Annotators with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language learning.

name.evidence: In this paper, we introduce Video-MME , the first-ever full-spectrum, MultiModal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis.

rai:dataCollection.evidence: The construction of the Video-MME dataset involves three main steps: video collection, question-answer annotation, and quality review.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: we first establish a domain hierarchy for sourcing raw videos from YouTube.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: we first establish a domain hierarchy for sourcing raw videos from YouTube.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: we provide the text-only questions to Gemini 1.5 Pro and filter out QA pairs that can be answered solely based on the textual questions.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: each annotator is tasked with thoroughly viewing the entire video, then iteratively creating three relevant questions, each accompanied by four candidate options

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: each QA pair undergoes examination by a different annotator to verify that (i) the language expression is clear and precise; (ii) the question is answerable with logically consistent candidate options, and the designated correct answer is appropriate.

rai:annotationsPerItem.evidence: annotate a set of 2,700 high-quality multiple-choice questions (3 per video)

rai:annotatorDemographics.evidence: recruit annotators with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language leaming.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: we introduce Video-MME, which is designed to evaluate MLLMs on video understanding tasks.
